metaShifts.description: Building on 7.37c's support item nerfs, this patch delivers the killing blow with massive nerfs to Arcane Boots (+100 cost, -0.25 mana regen, -25 mana restore), Guardian Greaves (+100 cost), and all defensive items (Crimson Guard -1s duration, Pavise -50 barrier/-1s duration, Pipe -2s duration, Solar Crest comprehensive nerfs). The removal of stat item scaling at 25 minutes eliminates late-game support relevance. This creates a complete paradigm shift away from item-dependent support play.

Gleipnir receives devastating nerfs: +300 cost, -5 damage, -5 attack speed, -25 health, -20 chain lightning damage. Combined with the previous patch's -50 health nerf, this item is now completely unviable. This specifically targets intelligence cores and utility carries who relied on Gleipnir as a core farming/teamfight item, reversing the 7.37c intelligence core rehabilitation attempt.

While other roles suffer item nerfs, strength cores receive targeted buffs: Lifestealer Feast scaling increased significantly (+0.25% at all levels), Beastmaster Primal Roar duration buffs, Tidehunter Ravage damage increases. With support items weakened and Gleipnir eliminated, strength cores who build different items and rely on innate tankiness become dominant.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Lifestealer's massively buffed Feast (+0.25% max HP damage/lifesteal at all levels) synergizes with Spirit Vessel's improved healing reduction (50% to 60%). Lifestealer can now burst down high-HP targets while Spirit Vessel prevents enemy healing, creating a devastating anti-tank combination.

Heroes like Lifestealer, Beastmaster, and Tidehunter benefit from the systematic weakening of support defensive items (Pipe, Crimson Guard, Pavise all nerfed). Their innate tankiness and built-in sustain become relatively stronger when supports can't provide adequate protection to their team.

synergisticWinners.entity: Early Game Aggression + Arcane Boots Nerfs
synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: The massive Arcane Boots nerfs (+100 cost, reduced mana efficiency) delay support power spikes significantly. Heroes that excel at early aggression before supports come online (like buffed Bloodseeker with 0 mana cost Bloodrage) can exploit this extended vulnerability window.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The complete destruction of Gleipnir (+300 cost, comprehensive stat nerfs) eliminates a core farming and teamfight item for intelligence heroes. This reverses the 7.37c intelligence core rehabilitation, as heroes like Invoker (also nerfed with Ghost Walk regen reductions) lose both their key item and direct power.

The systematic destruction of support items (Arcane Boots, Guardian Greaves, all defensive items nerfed) combined with stat item scaling removal creates a cascade failure. Support duos can no longer provide adequate mana, healing, or protection, making dual support lineups unviable.

synergisticLosers.entity: Late Game Scaling + Stat Item Nerfs
synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The removal of stat item doubling at 25 minutes (Bracer, Null Talisman, Wraith Band) eliminates a key late-game scaling mechanism. Heroes that relied on extended games with multiple stat items for late-game relevance lose this scaling entirely.

Carry.explanation: Massive Feast buffs (+0.25% max HP damage/lifesteal at all levels) make him the premier tank-killing carry. With support items weakened, his built-in sustain and magic immunity become relatively stronger, allowing him to dominate teamfights.

Duelist damage increase (10% to 12%) provides more scaling, while the systematic weakening of support defensive items makes his Omnislash more effective. His built-in magic immunity and healing ward provide self-sufficiency when supports are weakened.

Illusory Armaments buffs (65% to 70% base damage for illusions, plus percentage damage scaling fix) increase his damage output significantly. With Gleipnir nerfed, fewer heroes can effectively clear his illusions in teamfights.

Mid.explanation: Base damage increase (+2) and Exorcism spirit count buffs (8/16/24 to 10/17/24 at levels 1-2) improve her laning and teamfight presence. As a strength-based mid, she benefits from the meta shift away from intelligence cores.

Reaper's Scythe cooldown reduction (110s to 100s) increases his teamfight frequency. With support items weakened and healing reduced across the board, his percentage-based damage and healing denial become more valuable.

Offlane.explanation: Primal Roar duration buffs (2.75/3.25/3.75s to 3/3.5/4s) provide significantly more lockdown. With support items weakened, his ability to isolate and eliminate key targets becomes more impactful in teamfights.

Ravage damage increases (250/350/450 to 275/375/475) improve his teamfight impact. As a strength-based initiator, he benefits from the weakened support ecosystem being unable to adequately protect against his initiation.

SoftSupport.explanation: Nether Swap cooldown buffs (50/40/30s to 46/38/30s) increase her playmaking frequency. Her percentage-based aura and positioning-based impact are less dependent on the nerfed item ecosystem than other supports.

HardSupport.explanation: Fowl Play invulnerability duration increase (0.75s to 1s) provides better survivability. His ability to provide lockdown and push without relying heavily on the nerfed support items makes him relatively stronger.

Carry.explanation: Lucent Beam damage nerfs (80/160/240/320 to 75/150/225/300) reduce her farming speed and teamfight damage. As an agility carry who doesn't benefit from the strength core buffs, she's relatively weaker in the new meta.

Mana Shield now disabling Blink Dagger creates a significant positioning problem. With support items nerfed and unable to provide adequate protection, her reduced mobility makes her much more vulnerable.

Mid.explanation: Ghost Walk regeneration nerfs (health regen roughly halved, mana regen reduced by ~20%) significantly impact his laning sustain and escape mechanism. Combined with Gleipnir destruction, he loses both survivability and core itemization.

Puckish base restoration nerfs (20 to 15 health/mana) and Dream Coil duration reduction at early levels hurt laning and teamfight impact. With support items weakened, the reduced self-sustain is more punishing.

Offlane.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs including base stats (315 to 310 MS, 23 to 22 STR) and mana costs (+10 on Purification and Repel) significantly impact his laning and teamfight presence. The support item nerfs also reduce his team's overall survivability.

Nature's Guise movement speed reduction (12% to 10%) and Leech Seed damage/heal nerfs (20/35/50/65 to 15/30/45/60) reduce his utility. With support items weakened, his team can't capitalize on his initiation as effectively.

SoftSupport.explanation: Enchant slow duration nerfs (5s to 3.5/4/4.5/5s at early levels) and Sproink cooldown increase (8s to 10s) reduce her early game impact. The Gleipnir nerfs also eliminate a core item for her farming and teamfight presence.

Leap Aghanim's Shard nerf preventing multiple Starstorm hits reduces her teamfight damage significantly. With support items weakened, she can't provide the same level of utility and damage to justify her pick.

HardSupport.explanation: Despite minor agility gain buffs, the systematic destruction of support items (especially Arcane Boots and Guardian Greaves) devastates her ability to provide mana and sustain to her team. Her talent nerf also reduces her scaling.

While Frost Shield receives damage reduction buffs, the massive nerfs to support items mean he can't provide adequate mana or healing support. The removal of stat item scaling also hurts his late-game survivability.
